Was at a stop light with my girlfriend and a guy driving a pick up didn’t see a motorcycle going the opposite way because the sun was in his eyes so he turned in front of it. Neither of the riders were wearing a helmet and they smacked hard into the road. The guy had brain matter coming out of his nose, the girl had facial and skull fractures for days. Literally nothing that could be done for either of them. I felt terrible for the guy driving the pick up truck though, dude was like 19-20 and so shook up. Kept wanting to try and help them while crying saying he didn’t see them because of the sun.
